His other hand rests only on a safe solid table corner away from the blade and log travel. Preserve the source timber table, metal corner brackets, clamp and one raw log. No floating wood or hidden foot behind a post. Retain exactly the same five actors, their distinct useful roles, all dog/wolf/owls anatomy and gear, owl on perch with clear wings, separate raw supply and bound finished plank units, snow ground, header, footer and composition. The pets are already correct and must not be redesigned. Current goods in input1 are correct and must retain their sizes, identities and quantities.
